sig: [[["A", "Lisa, have you got a minute? I want to plan the database migration."], ["B", "Sure, James. Are we still doing it this weekend?"], ["A", "Yes, on Saturday night. We'll start at 10 p.m., when traffic is lowest."], ["B", "How long will it take?"], ["A", "About six hours, if everything goes well. So we should finish by 4 a.m., well before anyone logs in on Sunday morning."], ["B", "OK. Who's going to be on call?"], ["A", "I'll take Saturday night, and Raj will cover Sunday in case anything breaks."], ["B", "I can be the backup on Saturday. I'll keep my phone on, so just call me if you need help. Do we have a rollback plan, too?"], ["A", "Yes, I wrote one last week. If something goes wrong, we can switch back to the old server in about thirty minutes. Oh, and could you give the customer support team a heads-up? They should know the system will be down."], ["B", "No problem. I'll email them this afternoon."]], {"A": "M-GB", "B": "F-US"}]
